method.scope: All 33 historical audit rows whose assessment was exactly/started with Referenz bestätigt (ChEMBL-Key); 26 unique ChEMBL records.
method.pubchem: PUG REST by the exact fixture label, plus query by the ChEMBL preferred name; selected/summarized same-connectivity records; raw query errors retained.
method.chembl: Live ChEMBL molecule JSON for each of the 26 source IDs; RDKit FindMolChiralCenters(includeUnassigned=True,useLegacyImplementation=False), computed InChIKey/formula retained.
method.selection: No reference changed from a resolver response. A source was changed only where the named PubChem main record and independent ChEMBL/ChEBI record agreed on the more specific stereo structure.
